sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Kirin Global Supplies is a leading distributor of sign supplies, automotive restyling films, architectural finishes, plastics, and construction materials that has been operating since 1985.

Industry: Wholesale Distribution · HQ: Phoenix, Arizona · Size: <$50M · Products: Sign Products, Digital Printing Media, Vinyl, Automotive Restyling Films, Architectural Films, Heat Transfer Vinyl

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Kirin Global Supplies scores 38 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by application fit (25/25). Nothing was found for event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (55% similar on vinyl, films, sign, film); Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (51% similar on films, vinyl, wrap, architectural); Drytac (34% similar on films, vinyl, media, film). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Event engagement: Confirming attendance at one more show would add points.
• Flags on the record: size third party estimate
